info.title: API.SH: StreetEasy
info.description: The StreetEasy API from API.SH: public StreetEasy data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
A real estate agent's public profile on StreetEasy (New York City and North Jersey): name, title, brokerage, licence (holder, number, type, expiry, state), business phone and email, photo, bio, languages, neighborhoods, social links, expert and pro badges, deal counts, active sale and rental listings (address, unit, area, type, beds, baths, size, price, photo, link), past sales, past rentals and closings (side, address, coordinates, beds, baths, size, price, closing date), buildings the agent knows (with deal counts) and client testimonials. Listings come 20 per page and deals 10 per page: pass a section's `next_page` back as `listings_page` or `deals_page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/streeteasy-agent

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An agent profile link (streeteasy.com/profile/<id>-<name>).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The profile id (the number in the profile link; `profile_id` of a /streeteasy/v1/listing agent).

parameters.name: listings_page
parameters.description: Page of the active sale and rental listings (default 1).

parameters.name: deals_page
parameters.description: Page of the past sales, rentals and closings (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
StreetEasy's areas: boroughs, neighborhood groups, neighborhoods and North Jersey cities with their ids, slugs, parent area and rentals/sales links. Use the names, slugs or ids as `area` in /streeteasy/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/streeteasy-areas

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Only areas inside this one (name, slug or id).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only areas whose name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One StreetEasy building: name, address, area and its parents, coordinates, type, status, year built, floors, unit count, complex, description, amenities, building policies and pet policy, tax abatement, sales and leasing start dates, nearby subway stations with their lines and distance, nearby parks, schools and other places, photos, floor plans, videos and 3D tour, and every unit for rent and for sale in it now (price, net effective rent, beds, baths, size, availability, link), plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/streeteasy-building

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A streeteasy.com/building/<name> link.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The building slug instead (the-eugene).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The building id instead (from a listing's building.id).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: The Eugene
example.description:
*Now offering in-person tours and virtual tours! Inquire for details.*

The Eugene, Manhattan West’s rental homes in the Hudson Yards Distri…

get.description:
One StreetEasy rental or sale: address and unit, status, price, net effective rent, months free, lease term, security deposit, monthly, move-in and other fees (rentals), maintenance, taxes, common charges, financing allowed, sold price and date (sales), price changes, full listing history with past prices and statuses, rooms, beds, baths, size, amenities and features, description, days on market, open houses, the listing brokerage and agents with phone numbers, MLS number, photos, floor plans, videos and 3D tour, the building, recent price stats for the area and similar listings, plus `raw`. Off-market and past listings work too.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/streeteasy-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A streeteasy.com listing link: /building/<building>/<unit>, /rental/<id> or /sale/<id>.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The listing id instead of a link (rental and sale ids overlap: pass type too).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Rental or sale, with id. Without it, the listing on the market is chosen when both exist.

parameters.name: similar
parameters.description: Include up to 12 similar listings (default true).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.description: Experience elevated Manhattan living in this **stunning penthouse-level studio residence at The Eugene**, offering breathtaking city views, …

get.description:
Search StreetEasy's New York City and North Jersey rentals or sales with every filter the site offers: areas (boroughs, neighborhoods, NJ cities), price, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, amenities, building type, subway lines, no fee, pets, by owner, prewar, new development, 3D tour or video, open house dates, move-in dates, ZIP code, keywords and listing status, including rented and sold history. Sales add maintenance, taxes, price per square foot, year built, sale type and income-restricted filters. Each listing has its id, link, address, unit, area, building type, status, price, net effective rent, months free, lease term, fees flag, price change, beds, baths, size, broker, coordinates, next open house and photos, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/streeteasy-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Rentals (default) or sales.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Areas, comma separated: names, slugs or ids from /streeteasy/v1/areas (e.g. manhattan, astoria, park-slope, hoboken). Default: all of NYC and NJ.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price (monthly rent or sale price, USD).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price (monthly rent or sale price, USD).

parameters.name: min_beds
parameters.description: Fewest bedrooms (0 = studio).

parameters.name: max_beds
parameters.description: Most bedrooms.

parameters.name: min_baths
parameters.description: Fewest bathrooms.

parameters.name: max_baths
parameters.description: Most bathrooms.

parameters.name: min_sqft
parameters.description: Smallest size in square feet.

parameters.name: max_sqft
parameters.description: Largest size in square feet.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Required amenities, comma separated: washer_dryer, dishwasher, elevator, city_view, private_outdoor_space, central_ac, furnished, fireplace, storage_space, loft, guarantors_accepted, garden_view, park_view, skyline_view, water_view, doorman, laundry, gym, parking, shared_outdoor_space, pool, pied_a_terre_allowed, childrens_playroom, smoke_free.

parameters.name: building_type
parameters.description: Building types, comma separated: condo, co_op, house, multifamily, rental.

parameters.name: transit_lines
parameters.description: Near these subway or rail lines, comma separated: 1-7, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, J, L, M, N, Q, R, S, W, Z, HBLR, PATH.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Listing status (default active). listed = active or in contract; rented applies to rentals, sold to sales.

parameters.name: no_fee
parameters.description: Rentals: only no-fee listings.

parameters.name: by_owner
parameters.description: Rentals: only listings by owner.

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: Only pet-friendly listings.

parameters.name: prewar
parameters.description: Only prewar buildings.

parameters.name: new_development
parameters.description: Only new developments.

parameters.name: has_3d_tour
parameters.description: Only listings with a 3D tour.

parameters.name: has_video
parameters.description: Only listings with a video.

parameters.name: income_restricted
parameters.description: Sales: only income-restricted units.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A 5-digit ZIP code.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words that must appear in the listing description.

parameters.name: building_id
parameters.description: Only units in this building (its id from /streeteasy/v1/building).

parameters.name: open_house_from
parameters.description: Open house on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: open_house_to
parameters.description: Open house on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: available_from
parameters.description: Rentals: available on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: available_to
parameters.description: Rentals: available on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: min_maintenance
parameters.description: Sales: lowest monthly maintenance or common charges.

parameters.name: max_maintenance
parameters.description: Sales: highest monthly maintenance or common charges.

parameters.name: min_taxes
parameters.description: Sales: lowest monthly taxes.

parameters.name: max_taxes
parameters.description: Sales: highest monthly taxes.

parameters.name: min_price_per_sqft
parameters.description: Sales: lowest price per square foot.

parameters.name: max_price_per_sqft
parameters.description: Sales: highest price per square foot.

parameters.name: min_year_built
parameters.description: Sales: built in or after this year.

parameters.name: max_year_built
parameters.description: Sales: built in or before this year.

parameters.name: sale_type
parameters.description: Sales: sale types, comma separated: sponsor_unit, foreclosure, resale, restricted_sale.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default recommended).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Listings per page, 1-200 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
